calls.title: A pasted picture reaches the agent as a path it opens, not as an attachment
calls.context: Claude Code lifted a bare image path out of the paste and attached the picture, which sent the image but lost its section
calls.chose: write the path in brackets, so the map arrives whole and the agent opens each picture itself
calls.because: it is what the approved plan says, it keeps every picture on its section for every agent, and it stops notes being cut in two; a test with neutral notes showed a real agent opening both pictures and placing them correctly
passed_over: keep the attachment and say the order in the map: depends on one agent's paste rule, and still cuts notes in two
paste the map, then paste the paths: attachments and a whole map, but timing-dependent and Claude-only
